test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is the highest peak of West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandakphu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandakphu is the highest peak in West Bengal** and is located in the** Darjeeling district.**
 
• It has an elevation of** 3,636 meters (11,930 feet) **and is also known as the **"Trekkers Wonderland."**
 
• From Sandakphu, one can get a panoramic view of four of the highest peaks in the world, including **Mount Everest, Makalu, Lhotse, and Kanchenjunga.**
 
• Sandakphu is a popular trekking destination and attracts adventure enthusiasts from all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saramati is the highest peak in Nagaland **and is located on the India-Myanmar border.
 
• **Doddabetta is the highest peak in Tamil Nadu **and is located in the Nilgiri range.
 
• **Deomali is the highest peak in Odisha** and is located in the Eastern Ghats range.

***Hence, The correct answer is option 1.***
